messages:
Sasha: Auditor wants a compact evidence bundle proving the RoleBinding change for svc-inference-writer in prod was done via the approved change and that KMS decrypts during the vuln triage are traceable. Need chain-of-custody.
Liam: Provide PR/CL link, k8s audit snippet for RoleBinding update, cloud audit entry (CloudTrail/GCP), KMS Decrypt/Sign events with principal and keyId, incident ticket, and a signed manifest with sha256s.
Sasha: We'll redact IPs and session tokens. Auditor said principal + requestId + timestamp must remain.
Jane_auditor: Redactions OK. Keep principal, requestId, action, resource, timestamp. Also need proof artifacts are immutable (object-lock or signed manifest) and key rotation history.
Marta: For KMS rotation: alias/rdw-compliance-manifests -> keyId/abcd-1234 -> last_rotated=2026-01-12. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/rotations/rdw-manifests. We'll include attestation.
Liam: KMS CSV fields: timestamp, principalArn, eventName, keyId, requestId. That covers keyId list.
Sasha: Bundle layout: logs/, manifest.json, manifest.sig, export_metadata.txt. Command used and sha256 of the final bundle in export_metadata.txt.
archives_bot: archive: s3://redwood-audit-exports/1876543210/svc-inference-evidence.tar.gz (object-lock enabled). Presigned link expires in 7 days.
Sasha: Uploaded, manifest signed with alias/rdw-compliance-manifests, redaction notes included.
Jane_auditor: Received. Quick follow-up: confirm no other key aliases used in triage window 2026-02-10T09:00:00Z to 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z.
Liam: Will include alias->keyId mapping and filtered KMS events for that window.
Marta: Adding incident id VT-2026-0423 to export metadata for traceability.
Sasha: Action items assigned: Liam export logs, Marta attach rotation docs, Sasha produce signed manifest and upload. Jane to confirm.
Jane_auditor: Thanks — will validate hashes & signature and respond within 48h. :thumbsup:
Sasha: Closing thread once auditor confirms.
